submission.reasoning: On sysmonlinux-tcontreras-attack-range-643, user ubuntu wrote library-hijack source files in /home/ubuntu (evil_preload.c and myfopen.c, a fopen hook) starting 11:46. At 11:48 the user renamed evil_preload.c to prog.c and compiled it with gcc into /home/ubuntu/prog. Next the user created dll_hook.sh and run_hook.sh and set both to mode 777. At 11:50:17 'sudo ./run_hook.sh' ran 'sh ./dll_hook.sh' as root, and that script launched ./prog (proc-c4f0eb4556) as root. Afterwards the user wrote and compiled a further loader, run_dllhook. This matches T1574.006 (dynamic linker hijacking) used to run code as root. The ubuntu account's sudo use made it possible.
